 The Face Shop brings Korean skincare rituals into Diwali campaign
 The campaign links Korean skincare with festive occasions, using the ‘Before I go to the puja, glow’ format to encourage creators and consumers to share routines.
 afaqs! news bureau 
 29 Oct 2026 
 17:41
 IST Follow Us
 New Update The Face Shop has launched its festive campaign, ‘Glow Before You Go’, which places skincare at the start of festive preparation, before makeup, outfits, and other elements of getting ready.
 The campaign links Korean skincare routines with occasions such as pujas, Diwali dinners and festive parties. A social media format built around the line ‘Before I go to the puja, glow’ invites creators and consumers to share their festive plans and skincare routines.
 The campaign includes a hero film, creator-led content and social media activity, along with an on-ground retail activation. The Face Shop is also working with influencers, dermatologists and makeup artists to discuss skincare as part of the wider beauty routine.
 As part of the campaign, the brand is running a month-long pop-up at Terminal 2 of Mumbai Airport. Visitors can browse and purchase products from The Face Shop’s Korean skincare range.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by The Face Shop India (@thefaceshopindia_official) 
 “Festive beauty conversations in India usually start with the outfit and the makeup, and skincare gets squeezed in at the end, if at all. We wanted to reverse that order. Skincare is not the finishing touch; it is the foundation everything else sits on, and the best festive look is one that begins with healthy skin. For us, the real opportunity is to turn a last-minute scramble into a ritual people look forward to, and that is what ‘Glow Before You Go’ is about.” says Aashriya Sharma, head of marketing at The Face Shop.
 The campaign will run across digital platforms and at the Mumbai Airport pop-up through the festive season.
